strategy.title: Selection strategy
strategy.description: best_for_customer: the compatible combination that saves the most; priority: higher-priority deals first.

classes.title: Stacking classes
classes.description: Every deal has a class. Two deals on the same line combine when both classes list each other in combines_with (same class: stack_within).

stack_within.title: Deals of this class stack with each other

max_deals_per_line.title: Maximum deals stacked on one line

search_limit.title: Combinations searched (best_for_customer)
search_limit.description: Item deals per line and bundle/cart deals per cart compared exhaustively (2^n combinations).

coupons_default.title: New deals combine with coupons
coupons_default.description: Default of a deal's combinesWithCoupons (reported as couponsAllowed on quotes).

loyalty_default.title: New deals combine with loyalty points
loyalty_default.description: Default of a deal's combinesWithLoyalty (reported as loyaltyAllowed on quotes).
